newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in tight range in line with dlr/majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in tight range in line with dlr/majors.

text.p: The ringgit was bound to a narrow 13-point range amidst thin volume and in line with the trend in dollar/majors, dealers said on Friday.
They said there was little movement in the ringgit after mild overnight gains triggered by unwinding of long dollar positions and weakening of dollar/yen.

"There is little action in the afternoon. Deals are mainly commercial, it is not order-driven or speculative," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said. He said size of deals was also small at around 0.5 million to two million ringgit against several million ringgit on a normal trading day.
Volumes have fallen due to year-end and New Year holiday season. Tokyo is closed for the week and many dealers in other markets have not returned to work yet.
Dealers said ringgit was expected to stay in a narrow range in the near-term unless there was movement in dollar/majors.
"The overnight move is basically technical. There is support for dollar at 2.5250," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
Dealers said volumes should be back to normal next week when most dealers return and the Tokyo market reopens.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5240/50 a dollar.
